p06.why: Every player has a garbage-hand bad beat, and a flat 'that proves nothing' picks a fight with their gut in eight words.

p09.why: It turns the viewer's own record into the punchline and dares the lucky ones to keep watching.

p31.why: A self-mocking then-vs-now arc any regular recognises and tags a friend on, with the reel promising which year was right.

p22.why: A lived bad beat told mid-hand, ending on a question the viewer has to answer for themselves.

p25.why: Names the archetype every player has faced, the any-two caller, and hands them a number that flips who the villain is.

p14.why: Puts the viewer in the hand at the river and asks the self-doubt question they actually asked.

p35.why: A taggable friend type ('my aces always get cracked') with a blunt verdict the reel has to prove.

p12.why: Meets the 'rigged' rant head-on in one line, a disagreement with what the viewer felt last session.
